blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala takes another crack at Diana Shnaider when the two face off in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo. Their match is scheduled for Friday, with the time yet to be announced. Eala absorbed a 7-5, 6-4 heartbreaker against Shnaider in the Ningbo Open Round of 16 on October 22 in their first meeting on the WTA Tour.
